summary_ja: EuroHPCの一次資料から、JUPITERとAlice Recoqueの公表予算、契約範囲、負担主体、所有・運用主体を照合しました。JUPITERは取得・納入・設置・保守を含む見込総額2.73億ユーロ、Alice Recoqueは同じ範囲を含む約3.55億ユーロです。いずれもEuroHPC JUが50%を負担し、残りを参加国側が負担します。統合システム契約であるため、CPU・GPU・ストレージ等の単価には分解しません。Consensusは未完了です。
summary_en: EuroHPC primary sources were reconciled for the published budgets, contract scope, funding shares, ownership, and operation of JUPITER and Alice Recoque. JUPITER has an expected total budget of EUR 273 million and Alice Recoque approximately EUR 355 million, each covering acquisition, delivery, installation, and maintenance. EuroHPC JU funds 50 percent in both cases, with participating countries funding the remainder. These integrated-system values are not decomposed into CPU, GPU, storage, or other component prices. Consensus is incomplete.

sections.title_en: Compare EuroHPC exascale procurements by contract scope and funding structure
sections.summary_ja: 海外事例も、金額だけでなく含まれる役務、資金負担、所有・運用の境界をそろえて比較します。
sections.summary_en: Compare international cases using aligned service scope, funding shares, ownership, and operation rather than headline values alone.

items.name_ja: JUPITER：見込総額2.73億ユーロの共同負担型調達
items.name_en: JUPITER: EUR 273 million expected budget with shared public funding
items.statement_ja: EuroHPC JUは、JUPITERについて取得、納入、組立、ハードウェア・ソフトウェアの設置、保守を含む見込総額2.73億ユーロを公表しています。負担はEuroHPC JUが50%、ドイツ連邦政府とノルトライン＝ヴェストファーレン州が各25%です。EuroHPC JUが所有し、Forschungszentrum Jülichに設置、Jülich Supercomputing Centreが運用します。公募では性能と総所有費用、プログラマビリティ、汎用性、安定性、電力・エネルギー効率、実装密度が評価軸に含まれます。
items.statement_en: EuroHPC JU publishes an expected total budget of EUR 273 million for JUPITER covering acquisition, delivery, assembly, hardware and software installation, and maintenance. EuroHPC JU funds 50 percent, while the German federal government and North Rhine-Westphalia fund 25 percent each. EuroHPC JU owns the system, which is installed at Forschungszentrum Jülich and operated by the Jülich Supercomputing Centre. The call evaluates performance and total cost of ownership, programmability, versatility, stability, power and energy efficiency, and density.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: 共同出資型の大規模調達では、取得費だけでなく所有、設置、運用、保守の責任境界と、性能以外の評価軸を事前に定義する必要があります。
items.hpci_relevance_en: Shared large-system procurement requires advance definition of ownership, hosting, operation, maintenance boundaries, and evaluation dimensions beyond performance.
adoption_conditions_ja: 予算額、契約額、最終支払額を区別する。
取得・設置・保守・施設・電力・運用人員の包含範囲を確認する。
資金負担と所有権、運用責任、利用配分の関係を明示する。
adoption_conditions_en: Distinguish budget, contracted value, and final paid amount.
Verify inclusion of acquisition, installation, maintenance, facilities, power, and operations labor.
State the relationship among funding shares, ownership, operational responsibility, and allocation.

items.name_ja: Alice Recoque：約3.55億ユーロの多国共同調達
items.name_en: Alice Recoque: approximately EUR 355 million multinational procurement
items.statement_ja: 欧州委員会は、Alice Recoqueについて取得、納入、設置、保守を含む総予算約3.55億ユーロを公表しています。EuroHPC JUが50%、フランス、オランダ、ギリシャのJules Verneコンソーシアムが残り50%を負担します。EuroHPC JUが所有し、フランスのTGCCに設置され、GENCI/CEA、SURF、GRNETからなるコンソーシアムが運用します。公表値は概算総予算であり、最終支払額や構成部品単価ではありません。
items.statement_en: The European Commission publishes a total budget of approximately EUR 355 million for Alice Recoque covering acquisition, delivery, installation, and maintenance. EuroHPC JU funds 50 percent and the Jules Verne consortium of France, the Netherlands, and Greece funds the remaining 50 percent. EuroHPC JU owns the system; it will be hosted at TGCC in France and operated by the consortium of GENCI/CEA, SURF, and GRNET. The published value is an approximate total budget, not a final paid amount or component price.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: 複数国・複数機関で整備する場合、負担割合だけでなく、運用統治、利用配分、データ越境、障害時責任を契約設計に含める必要があります。
items.hpci_relevance_en: Multinational and multi-institution deployment requires contractual treatment of operational governance, allocation, cross-border data, and incident responsibility in addition to funding shares.
adoption_conditions_ja: 参加主体別の負担、所有、運用、利用配分を対応付ける。
導入遅延、為替、保守、施設増強の負担者を確認する。
国境・機関をまたぐ認証、データ、障害対応の規則を明示する。
adoption_conditions_en: Map each participant's funding, ownership, operation, and allocation.
Identify who bears schedule delay, currency, maintenance, and facility-upgrade risks.
State rules for cross-border and cross-institution identity, data, and incident response.
